shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next configs ---'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \\( -name 'next.config.*' -o -name 'AGENTS.md' \\) -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductList.tsx app/Recommendations.tsx; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- docs matches ---'; rg -n -i \"partial pre.?render|ppr|cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- cacheComponents config doc ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/04-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant docs filenames ---'; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg -i 'cacheComponents|partial|ppr|static-and-dynamic|public-static'; printf '%s\\n' '--- public static PPR section ---'; sed -n '175,250p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/public-static-pages.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md; printf '\\n--- cache components guide intro ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md; printf '\\n--- package installed version ---\\n'; node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: next.config.ts
@@
-const nextConfig: NextConfig = {}
+const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
+  cacheComponents: true,
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check
git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json
git status --short"
